$comment: Approved direct npm dependencies for web/ (NFR-SEC-9). Adding, removing or re-classifying an entry requires a reviewed PR. scripts/check-dependency-policy.mjs enforces this file in CI before any install runs. 'runtime' entries ship to browsers; 'dev' entries are build/test tooling only and never reach the bundle or the runtime image.

react-dom.justification: Browser renderer for React (client-only; react-dom/server is never imported).

@fluentui/react-components.justification: Accessible component library (PRD §8.1). Not installed until the first functional screen.

@fluentui/react-icons.justification: Icon set paired with Fluent UI (status icons alongside text, NFR-A11Y-1). Not installed until needed.

cytoscape.justification: Graph explorer canvas (screen 6), 3.34.4 from slice 6 (DEC-046 item 3); its one injected <style> is pre-created with the page nonce (src/graph/cytoscapeStylesheet.ts).

react-router.justification: Client-side routing for stable deep links (US-53), library mode only. Not installed until slice 5.

vite.justification: Bundler for the browser-only SPA (D1). Used with its built-in JSX transform; no React plugin.

typescript.justification: Type checking (tsc --noEmit). Held on 6.0.x until typescript-eslint supports 7.x.

@types/node.justification: Type definitions for build/test configuration files that run in Node.js (vite.config.ts, Playwright). Never in the browser bundle.

eslint.justification: Lint, including the NFR-SEC-9 bans on dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval and new Function.

typescript-eslint.justification: TypeScript parser and rules for ESLint.

@playwright/test.justification: Browser smoke test proving the SPA renders under the production CSP and Trusted Types (PRD §8.1 lists Playwright). Uses a system Chrome/Chromium; browsers are never downloaded by an install script.

@axe-core/playwright.justification: Automated axe accessibility checks in the Playwright end-to-end suite (NFR-A11Y-3; PRD §8.1 "Playwright + axe"). Test-only: runs in the smoke test, never reaches the bundle or the image. Brings axe-core (MPL-2.0).
